violations.title: Separation of Raw Animal and RTE Foods
violations.observation: Raw animal food storage, preparation, holding or display conducted in a manner that may cause cross contamination of ready-to-eat food as follows: raw chicken in the 2DR prep top cooler on the cook line, was being stored above butter and ready to use salad dressings. In the walk-in refrigerator, raw beef was being stored next RTE cucumber.
violations.corrective_action: Food shall be protected from cross contamination by separating raw animal foods like poultry, beef, pork, seafood, and eggs from cooked foods, ready-to- eat foods, washed produce, etc during storage, preparation, holding or display. Raw foods shall be stored on shelving units BELOW or SEPARATED from all cooked foods, commercially processed foods, washed produce, leftover foods, etc. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT ALL RAW FOODS NEED TO BE STORED BELOW READY TO EAT FOODS TO PREVENT THE POTENTIAL OUT BREAK OF A FOOD BORNE ILLNESS. PIC REARRANGED THE 2DR PREP TOP ON THE COOK LINE AND WALK-IN REFRIGERATOR TO MAKE SURE ALL RAW FOODS WERE BEING PROPERLY STORED.

out_items.name: Toxic substances properly identified, stored, and used

violations.title: Restricted Use Pesticide, Conditions of use
violations.observation: Restricted, commercial use pesticides present in the facility are applied by the operator who is not a certified pesticide applicator.
violations.corrective_action: Because of their toxicity, restricted use pesticides must be applied by a certified pesticide applicator to prevent injury and contamination. EHS DISCUSSED WITH PIC THAT HOME USE PESTICIDES ARE NOT ALLOWED TO BE USED IN THE RESTAURANT AND MUST ONLY BE SPRAYED BY A CERTIFIED PEST CONTROL OPERATOR. PIC THREW AWAY HOME PESTICIDES.

out_items.name: Proper eating, tasting, drinking, or tobacco use

violations.title: Eating, Drinking, or Using Tobacco
violations.observation: Open drinking containers used or stored in a manner that may contaminate food, food contact surfaces or utensils. Observed open drink on prep table next to bread being cut.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees may have beverages in the kitchen areas as long as they are covered and consumed through a straw and stored in a manner that will prevent contamination to food, equipment, utensils, linens, and single service items. CDI removed drink

violations.title: Proper Thawing Methods for ROP Fish
violations.observation: Observed ROP salmon in refrigerator in original plastic packaging
violations.corrective_action: Packages must be cut to allow oxygen inside while thawing. CDI bags cut
